d: Straight, shoulder-length silver-white hair with long bangs framing the face is partially covered by a purple hood. The eyes are a sharp, narrow gold shade with a confident expression, set on a youthful face with a mature air. The build is slender with an athletic frame, dressed in a purple and magenta tattered kimono-style outfit featuring a black mesh crop top, black fishnet stockings, and black armored boots. A white and red kitsune mask rests atop the head, complemented by a black belt with pouches and a katana held in the left hand.
